blocks.text: The Association of Southeast Asian Nations (Asean) on Sunday reaffirmed its decision to keep Myanmar excluded from the bloc’s key meetings until it makes “meaningful progress” in implementing a peace plan aimed at ending violence following the country’s 2021 coup.
